assumptions: Hardware values are docs/HARDWARE-MODELS.md presets, not measurements.
Workload is synthetic; it is not a captured serving trace.
Operation timing uses requests.tokens_per_second (assumed 50 when omitted); replay is open-loop.
Only expert parameter pages are modeled; attention and dense weights are out of scope for this profile.
description: MoE expert tiering: 4 layers x 16 experts (512 MiB of experts) on a node with 256 MiB of local DRAM. Zipf-skewed popularity decides which experts stay hot.

provenance.method: One-way latency and sustained bandwidth for a CXL.mem class link.
